recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration: (a) specify for each case, in the presumptive fraud reporting, the type of possible loss of resources; and (b) provide training materials to stakeholders, notably in the field, to facilitate and improve the financial estimation of fraud cases.

history.sg_progress: The full implementation of this recommendation is dependent on the approval of additional resources. The Administration plans to: (a) adapt the reporting tools to include and refine the different types of loss of United Nations resources; (b) continue to deliver an annual session on the ALD Connect online platform, working in close collaboration with the Office of Internal Oversight Services and the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, for conduct and discipline teams in order to provide guidance to missions on fraud reporting, especially for fraud focal points and finance officers in the field (information on the recovery of financial losses suffered by the Organization as a result of misconduct by staff members can be found in the report on the practice of the Secretary-General in disciplinary matters and cases of possible criminal behaviour, from 1 January to 31 December 2024 (A/80/533)); (c) hold workshops jointly with the Office of Internal Oversight Services to clarify definitions and methodology in order to facilitate and improve financial loss estimates; and (d) align templates for reporting to collect data on the type of possible loss.
